hero.description: A proactive Cyber Security Engineer leveraging a strong background in ethical hacking to build resilient defenses. Specialized in bridging the gap between offensive security and defensive operations, including vulnerability management, system hardening, and application security.

descriptions.Valde: As a proactive Cyber Security Engineer, I hold key responsibilities in strengthening the organization’s cyber defense infrastructure and enhancing its overall security posture. In this role, I actively manage a diverse portfolio of security operations, ranging from vulnerability management and privileged access control to cyber attack simulations and system hardening. Furthermore, I contribute to the organization’s application security with a holistic approach, both by conducting penetration tests on in-house applications and by coordinating end-to-end pentesting processes with third-party vendors. My responsibilities include:
descriptions.nscSoft: Specialized Penetration Tester proficient in identifying and securing vulnerabilities across networks, web applications, and mobile applications. Proven track record in delivering comprehensive assessments, staying current with cybersecurity trends, and effectively communicating technical findings to stakeholders.
descriptions.bgaSecurity1: As a Penetration Tester with expertise in web applications and APIs, I specialize in ensuring the security of computer systems by identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities. I have experience in conducting penetration testing of web applications and APIs and creating detailed reports outlining identified vulnerabilities and suggested remediation.
descriptions.bgaSecurity2: As a project manager with a strong background in leading cybersecurity teams, scoping and executing penetration tests, and delivering actionable insights to clients. My expertise in risk assessment, project management, and clear communication, coupled with my commitment to staying updated on industry trends, makes me a valuable asset in safeguarding digital assets and enhancing security postures for diverse organizations.

responsibilities.item1: Planning and executing regular Breach and Attack Simulations (BAS) to measure and enhance the organization’s resilience against cyber threats.
responsibilities.item2: Orchestrating the Vulnerability Management lifecycle to proactively identify, prioritize, and remediate security risks across the infrastructure.
responsibilities.item3: Ensuring the security of critical assets by managing Privileged Access Management (PAM) processes and enforcing least privilege principles.
responsibilities.item4: Minimizing the attack surface by performing security hardening across system and network infrastructures.
responsibilities.item5: Leading and implementing critical security projects from conception to completion, including secure file sharing, enterprise browser solutions, and web content filtering.
responsibilities.item6: Performing regular penetration tests on in-house web and mobile applications and conducting security assessments for new features and developments.
responsibilities.item7: Managing the entire lifecycle of third-party penetration testing engagements, from defining the scope and coordinating with vendors to analyzing findings and tracking remediation efforts.
responsibilities.item8: Conducting comprehensive penetration tests on web applications
responsibilities.item9: Preparing detailed reports with findings, risk assessments, and recommended remediation steps
responsibilities.item10: Collaborating with development teams to implement security best practices
